intervention: Same V49/V52 neural architecture and features; warm start each fold/full model from its corresponding selected V54 weights plus V55 bias. Update map encoder,context,GRU, base movement and geometry correction. Freeze code readout,code embeddings and goal-query/readout weights. A complete32-turn window forward/backward is freed before the next window; accumulate8windows with their common movement and observed-row denominators before one optimizer update.
objective: Supported movement CE plus code KL to the frozen matching warm-start teacher with weight1. All1607 existing fitting windows retained; four whole-game folds train other24games and validate the original64windows in held8games. No future/code labels in inputs. Full personal PRE/maps re-encoded for every window, with original masking and reset semantics.
selection: Evaluate epochs0,1,2. Choose most pooled correct moves among candidates losing at most 1percentage point of inferred-code accuracy vs warm start; then lowest movementNLL,earliest epoch. Refit one setting on all fitting windows; assess selected checkpoint once on unchanged research queries.
limitations: This also changes batch size/update cadence relative to V54; it does not isolate map weights as a unique cause. Previously exposed groups,inherited fitting-group exposure,observed command history,inferred codes,sparse goals and conditional movement. Frozen goal weights do not guarantee unchanged goal outputs when encoder states change. No subagents or promotion.
